title: ОписаниеСитуации (Речь)
description: Объясни, почему ситуация сложилась таким образом. Пример: I was hungry because I hadn't eaten breakfast. / The ground was wet because it had rained.

conditions.label: Past Perfect — причина (had + V3): что случилось раньше
conditions.hint: I was hungry because I hadn't eaten breakfast. / The ground was wet because it had rained.

conditions.label: Состояние/результат (was/were)
conditions.hint: I was hungry. / The ground was wet.

script.description: Примерные варианты (выбери один и объясни по образцу):
sentences: I was tired because I hadn't slept well the night before.
She was upset because she had lost her favourite pen.
They were late because they had missed the bus.
He was happy because he had passed his exam.
We were excited because we had bought tickets for the concert.
The room was dark because someone had turned off the lights.
The streets were empty because it had snowed heavily.
My phone was dead because I had forgotten to charge it.
The teacher was angry because the students hadn't done their homework.
I was nervous because I hadn't prepared for the test.
